user.title: Connect Surveillance Station
user.description: Use a dedicated DSM user without 2-step verification that has access to Surveillance Station.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of your NAS, e.g. 192.168.178.20
data_description.port: DSM port: 5001 for HTTPS, 5000 for HTTP
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off for a self-signed certificate

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach DSM. Check host, port and HTTPS setting.
error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check the credentials and make sure 2-step verification is off for this user.
error.no_surveillance: Logged in, but Surveillance Station did not answer. Is the package running and does the user have access?

data_description.lookback_hours: Only recordings in this window are listed in the card.
data_description.prefetch: Thumbnails are small JPEG files in the Home Assistant config folder under ss_recordings.
data_description.keep_clips: Off: clips are streamed from Surveillance Station when you play them and nothing is stored. On: clips are kept for instant replay, up to the cache size.
data_description.recordings_path: If Home Assistant runs on the NAS, mount the surveillance shared folder into the container (e.g. /surveillance) and enter the path here. Clips are then read directly from disk.

error.path_not_found: This folder does not exist inside the Home Assistant container.
